claims: The Isle of Man is a self-governing British Crown Dependency.
The Isle of Man is in the Irish Sea.
The Isle of Man TT is an annual motorcycle race.
The population of the Isle of Man is around 80,000–85,000.
Tynwald is the world’s oldest continuous parliament.
The Isle of Man has a 0% corporate tax rate.
The Isle of Man has no national speed limits on some roads.
Tynwald was founded by Vikings in 979.
The Isle of Man is the only entire nation to be a UNESCO Biosphere.
Castle Rushen is in Castletown.
The Manx Museum is in Douglas.
Douglas is the capital city of the Isle of Man.
The Manx cat is tailless.
Loaghtan sheep have six horns.
The currency of the Isle of Man is the Manx pound.
The Manx pound is equal to the British pound.
The Isle of Man is not part of the UK.
The Isle of Man is not part of Ireland.
The Isle of Man is not part of the EU.
The official languages of the Isle of Man are English and Manx.
Raad ny Foillan is a hiking trail.
